decision: Never infer exchange proof-of-reserves membership from an explorer label or from another chain's hot-wallet identity. Calculate asset-specific reserve coverage only after exact address-set matching and customer-liability reconciliation.
rules: Keep Binance14 EVM wallet and the five XRPL source accounts as distinct chain-specific entities.
CoinDesk's reported Binance14 inclusion in October 1 PoR supports an ETH coverage risk estimate only; do not transfer the approximately 94% ETH estimate to XRP.
Treat Bithomp/Whale Alert Binance labels and historical wallet rotations as operational-cluster evidence, not official PoR attestation.
XRP reserve shortfall remains unknown until all five XRPL addresses are matched against the October 1 downloadable PoR address list and XRP customer liabilities.
Use November 1 PoR to test replenishment, while preserving the October 1 baseline and the theft-time balances.
